payload.reason: The evidence provides specific performance improvements of the proposed similarity measure over BM25, quantified in terms of percentage increases in ranking metrics.

claims.text: The proposed similarity measure outperforms BM25 by increasing NDCG@20 by 23%, NDCG@10 by 25%, and NDCG@5 by 23%.
The embedding approach boosts the average precision of BM25 by 19% and 6% on TREC 2006 and 2007, respectively.
The proposed method achieves stronger performance than BM25 on TREC and PubMed datasets.
The new similarity measure based on Word Mover's Distance is better than BM25 ranking.
